data.standardized_narrative: At the 2014 year-end the Syndicate shows a net prior-year deterioration of GBP 11.1m (net of reinsurance) driven by increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims and by specific account developments (notably a Talisman emergence and reserve strengthening on older UK Solicitors' PI years). These adverse developments primarily affected the Property, Marine and Professional Lines areas, although the overall underwriting performance for the year remained satisfactory in parts of the portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 11.1m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: release of GBP 6.2m).

increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years, leading to a more modest (but still better than plan) 87% combined ratio for the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development (PYD) figure is not provided in gross terms in the report; only a net deterioration of GBP 11.1m is stated and has been used as a last-resort proxy (NET of reinsurance). No gross 'movement in prior year's provision' (insurance liabilities) figure or gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed notes. Lob-level PYD amounts are not quantified in the report and have been left null.
